label: Share
depicts: Three round nodes linked by two diagonal connector lines in a branching network
use_when: Use when the interface wants share to feel like connected points spreading through a small network.
avoid_when: Do not use for the arrow leaving a square when the share action should read like sending outward from a box.

label: Share
depicts: Open square frame with one arrow launching upward from the upper right corner
use_when: Use when the interface wants share to feel like pushing content out of a container or window.
avoid_when: Do not use for the connected node share when the mark should not resemble a branching network diagram.

label: Shoe
depicts: Low sneaker profile with a pointed toe and lace bumps and a flat sole trailing behind
use_when: Use when the interface wants a casual sneaker silhouette instead of formal or heeled footwear.
avoid_when: Do not use for the high heel pump when the shoe should not rise on a thin back heel.

label: Shoe
depicts: High heel silhouette with a curved top opening and pointed toe and thin raised heel
use_when: Use when the interface wants elegant heeled footwear instead of a low casual sneaker silhouette.
avoid_when: Do not use for the sneaker when the shoe should not show laces or a long flat sole.

label: Shopping Bag
depicts: Simple upright shopping bag with a flat base and straight sides and one rounded carry handle
use_when: Use when the interface wants the plainest bag silhouette with no flap or decorative inner opening.
avoid_when: Do not use for the bag variants with a smile like inner cutout or a folded top flap across the opening.
